caption: The drawing depicts a carved wooden statue of a standing human figure with brown skin, positioned on two rectangular grey platforms of different heights. The figure is dressed in a green wrap-around skirt and a green draped cloth over the shoulder, with details on the clothing edged in red, yellow, and gold tones. The figure's accessories include yellow-gold arm and ankle bands, a necklace of red beads, and leafy-looking adornments on the arms and legs. On the head, the figure wears a yellow headband with feather-like decorations in shades of red, yellow, and green, arranged in a fan shape. The right arm is raised and bent at the elbow, with the hand holding an upright, cylindrical object resembling a bundle or cigar; the left arm is extended downward, holding a green bag. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Cigar Store Indian
